text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet strikes a series of poses in
front of
a mirror by herself.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
There, fabulous! ...Wait, no, how about
this?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's only you... Don't scare me like
that.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I'm trying to figure out which pose
would best
match my signature
racewear.
choice_data_list: ごめん、集中してたんだな
ごめん、集中してたんだね
choice_data_list_en: Sorry, you were really focused, huh.
Sorry, you were really focused, weren't you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
They'll be taking my photo after I win,
so I can't
afford to look sloppy!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But nothing feels quite right... What do
you think
screams, "I'm number one!"?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Number one, hm? I see! That does sound
like me!
choice_data_list: “1番”をビシッとアピールする感じで
いつもの『ふふん♪』でいこう
choice_data_list_en: Show everyone you're 'Number One' with style!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But now I'm wondering about the best
way to
point...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Should I do it normally? Or should I lift
up my arm
above my head? I could even
make it a full-body
thing...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Argh, this is just turning into more
work... I'm
going to try some different
things out. You sit
there and watch,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Be warned, you're not getting away until
I figure
this out! This was your idea, so
you'd better take
responsibility!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I end up watching her experiment with
different
poses until the sun goes down.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ex-cuse me?! Was that supposed to be me?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I do not sound that childish! I'm way cooler and more mature!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well, you didn't! That didn't sound like me at all!
choice_data_list: 似てたと思うんだけど……
choice_data_list_en: I thought they looked alike, though...
I thought they seemed alike, though...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like she doesn't really know her
own
habits. I've learned something new
today.
